correctness.rationale: The inspected verifier enumerates every tournament through order five, computes the maximal lottery independently by rational support solving and by Pfaffian null vectors, and computes the uncovered set independently from covering and from the two-step-king criterion. It obtains strict-count sequence \(0,0,0,0,120\), the exact order-five census \(320,520,120,64\), and one strict canonical orbit of size 120. A separate independent enumeration reproduced the same strict-count sequence and the complete order-five size census. The canonical representative's lottery \((1/3,0,0,1/3,1/3)\) satisfies the exact equilibrium inequalities and its uncovered set has the stated four elements.

final_claim: The bipartisan and uncovered sets coincide in every tournament on at most four alternatives and first separate at order five; exactly 120 of the 1024 labelled five-alternative tournaments are strict, all with sizes three and four respectively, and all 120 form one isomorphism class, with the stated complete order-five joint-size census.
